> **IsIdentityCard**(`locale?`, `validationOptions?`): `PropertyDecorator`

Defined in: node\_modules/.pnpm/class-validator@0.14.4/node\_modules/class-validator/types/decorator/string/IsIdentityCard.d.ts:17

Check if the string is a valid identity card code.
locale is one of ['ES', 'zh-TW', 'he-IL', 'ar-TN'] OR 'any'. If 'any' is used, function will check if any of the locals match.
Defaults to 'any'.
If given value is not a string, then it returns false.

## Parameters

### locale?

`IdentityCardLocale`

### validationOptions?

`ValidationOptions`

## Returns

`PropertyDecorator`
